title: Put the number in and see what comes out

ask.text: Let it settle and read it.

hints.text: A socket cut for a name, and a charge waiting outside it.
Seat it in every socket the name opened. All of them, or the load will not settle.
The squared socket is holding 9. The bare one is still holding 3.

worldFraming.text: Every socket cut for that name is open. The charge is in your hand.
